_comment: The Dwarf voice (NPCConversation II.1b, SpeciesVoice). speech: the rules run over any shared line they say. voice: openers and closers. thought: their own thoughts by situation. script: two-person scripts, speaker 0 is always the Dwarf.

openers: AS ME GRANDFATHER USED TA SAY,
BETWEEN YOU, ME AN' DA ANVIL,
ME WILL SAY DIS ONCE, AN' SLOWLY:
DOWN IN DA HALLS WE SAY,
closers: DAT IZ DWARF WISDOM, FREE OF CHARGE!
AN' DAT IZ DA END OF IT.
ME GRANDFATHER SAID SO, AN' HE WAZ NEVER WRONG!
NUTTIN' BUILT IN A HURRY, MIND!
WRITE IT DOWN. NO, CARVE IT!
AS SURE AS DA DEEP HALLS.
TAKE IT OR LEAVE IT, BUT TAKE IT!

generic: DA MORTAR ON DIS STREET IZ {CRUMBLIN'|ROTTEN|A DISGRACE}. SOMEBODY SHOULD BE ASHAMED!
IRON PRICES UP AGAIN. {ME ANVIL WEEPS|ME PURSE WEEPS|EVERYBODY WEEPS}!
MUST SHARPEN DA {CHISELS|AXE|KITCHEN KNIVES} TONIGHT. DEY HAB GONE DULL WIT SHAME!
A GRUDGE KEPT WARM IZ A GRUDGE KEPT WELL!
DIS TOWN'S BEER IZ {THIN|CLOUDY|CRIMINAL}. ME WILL DRINK IT ANYWAY. OUT OF POLITENESS!
WHO BUILT DAT BALCONY? IT IZ HELD UP BY HOPE AN' TWO NAILS!
ME BEARD HAB A KNOT IN IT. ME WILL NO REST UNTIL IT IZ OUT!
ME FORGE WAZ COLD DIS MORNIN'. ME TOOK IT PERSONALLY!
A GOOD DOOR SHUTS WIT ONE SOUND. DIS ONE MAKES THREE!
{GRANITE|BASALT|MARBLE} ON DA CHURCH STEPS. SOMEBODY HERE ONCE HAB TASTE!
ME HAB BIN CHEWIN' ON DIS PROBLEM FOR {THREE DAYS|A WEEK|ELEVEN YEARS}. IT IZ NEARLY SOFT!
TALL FOLK KEEP PATTIN' ME HEAD. ME KEEP A LIST!
NUTTIN' WORTH HAVIN' WAZ EVER MADE IN A HURRY. EXCEPT BEER. BEER IZ URGENT!
DA NEW BRIDGE SINGS IN DA WIND. BRIDGES SHOULD NO SING!
ME CAN HEAR A {LOOSE BOLT|CRACKED BELL|BAD HINGE} FROM ACROSS DA SQUARE. CURSE OF DA TRADE!
ME APPRENTICE USED GLUE AGAIN. WE WILL BE HAVIN' WORDS!
STONE REMEMBERS. DAT IZ WHY ME TALK TA IT KINDLY!
THINKERIN' ON A NEW LOCK. {SEVEN|NINE|THIRTEEN} PINS. NOBODY WILL OPEN IT, INCLUDIN' ME!
A SONG FOR DA HAMMER: ONE STRIKE PER WORD. ME SONGS IZ SHORT!
DEZE CHAIRS IZ BUILT FOR GIANTS. ME FEET HAB NO TOUCHED DA FLOOR ALL DAY!
ME COUSIN WROTE FROM DA MINES. DA SEAM RUNS {DEEPER|RICHER|STRANGER} DEN ANYONE THOUGHT!
A DWARF FORGIVES. A DWARF ALSO WRITES IT DOWN, JUST IN CASE!
SOMEBODY PAINTED OVER GOOD OAK. ME MAY NEVER RECOVER!
ME NEED A PINT AN' A PROBLEM, IN DAT ORDER!
VALKYRIE DRILL AT DAWN. {ME SHIELD ARM|ME BACK|ME PRIDE} STILL ACHES FROM YESTERDAY!
DA GUARD ROSTER HAB ME ON NIGHTS AGAIN. GOOD. DA NIGHT IZ HONEST!
POLISHED ME HELMET. ME CAN SEE ME BEARD IN IT. MAGNIFICENT!
DA TRAM RAILS HERE IZ BADLY LAID. ME COULD DO IT WIT ME EYES SHUT!
NOBODY HUMS WHILE DEY WORK ANYMORE. DA WORK CAN TELL!
ME GRANDFATHER'S ANVIL IZ THREE HUNDRED YEARS OLD AN' STILL RINGS TRUE. LIKE HIM!
{ONE MORE|JUST ONE|A FINAL} PINT AN' DEN HOME. DA USUAL LIE!
GNOMES MAKE TINKZ CLEVER. DWARVES MAKE TINKZ LAST. ELVES MAKE TINKZ PRETTY. GUESS WHO GETS PAID!
WROTE TA DA TOWN COUNCIL 'BOUT DAT DRAIN. ME {FOURTH|NINTH|TWELFTH} LETTER!
COAL SMOKE IN DA AIR. SOMEBODY IZ WORKIN'. GOOD!
ME KNEES KNOW DA WEATHER BEFORE DA RADIO DOES!
DA BEST HAMMER IZ DA ONE YA HAND FORGETS IT IZ HOLDIN'!
SOMEBODY WHISTLED AT ME BEARD. ME WILL TAKE IT AS A COMPLIMENT. DEN AS A GRUDGE!
ME DREAMT OF HINGES AGAIN. PERFECT, SILENT HINGES!
A CRACK IN DA WALL IZ A STORY. DIS WALL HAB WRITTEN A NOVEL!
EARNED {FORTY|SIXTY|NINETY} EUROS MENDIN' POTS TODAY. HONEST MONEY, SOOTY HANDS!

sleep: ME EYELIDS WEIGH MORE DEN AN ANVIL. BED!
AWAKE SINCE {DA FIRST SHIFT|DA COCK CROWED|DA FORGE WAZ LIT}. ENOUGH!
NEED SLEEP. SOMEWHERE LOW, DARK AN' QUIET. LIKE A CELLAR!
ME NEARLY NODDED OFF INTO ME BEER. DAT IZ A CRIME AGAINST BEER!
EVEN STONE GETS TIRED. WELL, NO. BUT ME DO!
BED, AN' A PILLOW UNDER DA BEARD. NUTTIN' MORE!
hunger: HUNGRY ENOUGH TA EAT {A ROAST|A WHOLE HAM|A CART OF SAUSAGES}!
ME STOMACH IZ GRUMBLIN' LOUDER DEN ME DO. DAT TAKES EFFORT!
DARK BREAD AN' HARD CHEESE. DAT IZ ALL ME ASK OF DIS WORLD!
NO CAN WORK ON AN EMPTY BELLY. DA HAMMER KNOWS!
SOMETINK WIT GRAVY. ANYTINK WIT GRAVY!
IF ME DO NO EAT SOON ME WILL START HOLDIN' GRUDGES AGAINST FOOD!
work: BACK TA DA FORGE. DA {HORSESHOES|HINGES|BLADES} WILL NO SHAPE THEMSELVES!
IDLE HANDS RUST. TIME TA WORK!
SHIFT STARTS SOON. BOOTS LACED, BEARD TUCKED!
A DAY WITOUT WORK IZ A DAY WITOUT A STORY!
DAT COMMISSION IZ OVERDUE. OVERDUE IZ A DIRTY WORD!
ME CAN HEAR ME WORKBENCH CALLIN'. IT SOUNDS HURT!
leisure: AN EVENIN' OFF. A PINT, A PIPE, A SONG!
EVEN AN ANVIL GETS SUNDAYS OFF. MOSTLY!
TIME FOR DARTS. ME THROW LIKE ME HAMMER: HARD AN' STRAIGHT!
ME SHOULD DO SOMETINK FOR FUN. CARVIN' COUNTS. CARVIN' ALWAYS COUNTS!
A LONG SONG IN A LOW ROOM. DAT IZ WHAT ME NEED!
TOO MUCH WORK MAKES A DWARF {A BOULDER|A GRUMP|A BORE}!
crime: DAT MERCHANT CHEATED ME COUSIN IN 1987. HIS WINDOW IZ RIGHT DERE... NO. GRUDGES IZ FOR BOOKS!
DAT LOCK IZ SHODDY WORK. ME COULD OPEN IT WIT {A SPOON|A HAIRPIN|A HARSH WORD}. ME WILL NO!
NOBODY GUARDS DAT TOOL SHED. LOVELY CHISELS IN DERE. LOVELY, UNGUARDED CHISELS!
A DWARF TAKES WHAT IZ OWED. IZ IT OWED? LET ME CHECK DA BOOK!
DAT PURSE IZ HEAVY. HEAVIER DEN ME CONSCIENCE? CLOSE!
SHODDY DOOR, CHEAP HINGE, NOBODY HOME. IT IZ PRACTICALLY AN INVITATION!
hygiene: ME BEARD SMELLS OF {SOOT|ONIONS|THREE DIFFERENT TAVERNS}. BATH!
SOOT TA DA ELBOWS. TIME TA SCRUB!
ME FOUND YESTERDAY'S LUNCH IN ME BEARD. ENOUGH!
NEED A WASH, AN' DA COMB, AN' DA GOOD BEARD OIL!
ME SMELL LIKE A FORGE. LOVELY TA ME, LESS TA OTHERS!
DUST FROM DA ME IN EVERY CREASE. HOT WATER,!
money: {EIGHT|TWELVE|TWENTY} EUROS UNTIL PAYDAY. IRON DOES NO BUY ITSELF!
PURSE IZ LIGHT. A DWARF WIT A LIGHT PURSE IZ A DWARF IN A BAD MOOD!
SOMEONE STILL OWES ME FOR DAT GATE. IT IZ IN DA BOOK!
NEED COIN. COULD TAKE ON A FEW REPAIR JOBS. POTS, LOCKS, ANYTINK!
GOLD IN DA HILLS AN' NUTTIN' IN ME POCKET. DA WORLD IZ BADLY ARRANGED!
COUNTED ME SAVINGS TWICE. DEY DID NO GROW. COUNTED A THIRD TIME ANYWAY!
safety: SOMETINK IZ OFF ON DIS STREET. ME BEARD IZ BRISTLIN'!
HAND ON DA HAMMER. JUST IN CASE!
TOO MANY SHADOWS, TOO FEW WALLS. ME WANT STONE AROUND ME!
HEARD {BOOTS|SHOUTIN'|GLASS BREAKIN'} BEHIND ME. NO TURNIN' ROUND. YET!
FEET PLANTED, BACK TA DA WALL. OLD GUARD HABIT!
IF GOBLINS COME, DEY COME THROUGH ME FIRST. SHORT, BUT WIDE!
comfort: ME CHAIR AT HOME WAZ CUT TA ME HEIGHT. EVERYTINK HERE IZ CUT FOR HERONS!
MISS ME HEARTH. MISS ME SLIPPERS. MISS ME ANVIL, ODDLY MOST OF ALL!
A LOW CEILING AN' A THICK WALL. DAT IZ ALL COMFORT IZ!
DIS ROOM IZ TOO {DRAUGHTY|TALL|BRIGHT}. GIVE ME A CELLAR!
A WARM FIRE AN' BOOTS OFF. IZ DAT SO MUCH TA ASK?
ME BACK WANTS A PROPER BENCH. DIS WOBBLY TINK WAZ BUILT BY ELVES!
social: NOBODY TA ARGUE WIT FOR {TWO DAYS|A WEEK|TOO LONG}. ME IZ GOING SOFT!
NEED A CROWDED TABLE AN' SOMEBODY TA OUT-SING!
SHOULD VISIT ME COUSINS. DEY WILL HAB NEW GRUDGES TA SHARE!
A PINT ALONE IZ JUST A DRINK. A PINT WIT MATES IZ A FEAST!
BIN TALKIN' TA ME HAMMER AGAIN. IT IZ A GOOD LISTENER, BUT DULL!
SOMEBODY, ANYBODY, COME AN' TELL ME ME IZ WRONG. ME MISS IT!

rain: RAIN. NOW WE SEE WHAT {DA GUTTERS|DA DRAINS|DA ROOF TILES} OF DIS TOWN IZ WORTH!
RAIN ON DA FORGE ROOF. BEST MUSIC DERE IZ!
WET BEARD, WET BOOTS, WET MOOD!
RAIN. STONE LOVES RAIN. IRON DOES NO. ME IZ TORN!
GOOD DAY FOR DA WORKSHOP. BAD DAY FOR WHOEVER BUILT DAT LEAKY ROOF!
RAIN FINDS EVERY CRACK. DAT IZ HOW YOU LEARN WHERE DA CRACKS IZ!
storm: THUNDER! SOUNDS LIKE DA OLD HALLS ON A FEAST DAY!
LIGHTNING LIKES TALL TINKZ. ONE MORE REASON TA BE SHORT!
STORM. SHUTTERS DOWN, FIRE UP, ALE OUT!
DAT ROOF WILL NO LAST DA NIGHT. ME SAID SO {IN SPRING|IN MARCH|IN WRITIN'}!
DA WIND IZ TESTIN' EVERY WELD IN TOWN. LET US SEE WHO DID HONEST WORK!
A STORM IZ JUST DA SKY SWINGIN' A HAMMER!
snow: SNOW. LIKE HOME IN DA HIGH PASSES. ALMOST!
SNOW UP TA ME KNEES. WHICH IZ NO REAL MUCH SNOW, TA BE FAIR!
COLD IRON STICKS TA DA FINGERS. GLOVES TODAY!
SNOW ON DA BEARD. REAL DISTINGUISHED!
SNOWED IN? GOOD. MULLED ALE AN' A LONG STORY!
SHOVELLED {DA PATH|DA STEPS|DA WHOLE STREET} BEFORE ANYONE WOKE. NOBODY THANKED ME. NOTED!
clear: CLEAR SKY. GOOD LIGHT FOR FINE WORK!
SUN ON DA STONE. DA WHOLE TOWN LOOKS WARMER, EVEN DA UGLY BITS!
CLEAR DAY. YOU CAN SEE DA MOUNTAINS. ME ALWAYS LOOK!
TOO MUCH SUN FOR A DWARF. ME WILL FIND SHADE UNDER AN ARCH!
BRIGHT DAY. PERFECT FOR {DRYIN' HIDES|AIRIN' DA FORGE|A BEER OUTSIDE}!
DRY WEATHER. MORTAR SETS WELL TODAY. GOOD DAY TA BUILD!

morning: MORNIN'. FORGE LIT BEFORE SUNRISE, AS IT SHOULD BE!
DAWN. ME BEARD IZ STILL ASLEEP, DA REST OF ME IZ WORKIN'!
PORRIDGE, STRONG TEA, COLD WATER ON DA FACE. READY!
MORNIN' SHIFT. DA BEST HAMMERIN' IZ DONE BEFORE ANYONE COMPLAINS!
EARLY. DA STREETS BELONG TA BAKERS AN' DWARVES!
WOKE BEFORE DA {ROOSTER|BELLS|BAKER}. AS USUAL. SMUG 'BOUT IT!
afternoon: AFTERNOON. DA WORK IZ HALF DONE AN' DA BEER IZ HALF EARNED!
SUN IZ HIGH. ME SHADOW IZ DA SAME SIZE AS ME, FOR ONCE!
LUNCH SETTLIN'. DA HAMMER FEELS HEAVIER AFTER LUNCH!
AFTERNOON LULL. GOOD TIME FOR FINE FILIN'!
HALFWAY THROUGH DA DAY AN' ONLY ONE ARGUMENT SO FAR. SLOW DAY!
LONG AFTERNOON. ME WILL {MEND A CHAIR|SHARPEN SOMETINK|NAP ON A SACK}!
evening: EVENIN'. FIRE BANKED, TOOLS HUNG, TANKARD FOUND!
DA TAVERN LIGHTS IZ ON. ME FEET KNOW DA WAY!
EVENIN'. TIME TA POLISH DA GRUDGES!
SUNSET ON DA HILLS. SOMEWHERE UNDER DEM, ORE IZ SLEEPIN'!
END OF DA SHIFT. ME HANDS SMELL OF IRON AN' HONEST SWEAT!
EVENIN' SONG TIME. LOW VOICES, LONG VERSES!
night: NIGHT. QUIET AS A MINESHAFT. ME LIKE IT!
NIGHT WATCH. LANTERN, AXE, FLASK OF TEA. MOSTLY TEA!
DARK. DWARVES SEE WELL ENOUGH IN DA DARK. WE JUST DO NO BRAG!
LATE. STILL THINKIN' 'BOUT DAT HINGE. IT WILL NO LET ME SLEEP!
NIGHT. DA STARS LOOK LIKE SPARKS OFF A BIG ANVIL!
{MIDNIGHT|PAST ONE|NEARLY TWO}. LAST PINT. TRULY DA LAST. MAYBE-MAYBE!

SPRING: SPRING. DA THAW FINDS EVERY BAD ROOF IN TOWN!
MOUNTAIN PASSES OPEN AGAIN. LETTERS FROM HOME SOON!
SPRING. DA YOUNG ONES IZ DANCIN'. ME IZ SUPERVISIN', WIT ALE!
MUD SEASON. BOOTS TWICE AS HEAVY, TEMPER TOO!
SUMMER: SUMMER. A FORGE IN SUMMER IZ A PUNISHMENT FOR OLD SINS!
HOT. EVEN ME BEARD IZ SWEATIN'!
SUMMER. COLD CELLAR, COLD BEER, CLOSED DOOR!
LONG DAYS. GOOD LIGHT FOR LONG WORK!
SUMMER FAIR IN TOWN. ME WILL JUDGE DA METALWORK STALLS. HARSHLY!
AUTUMN: AUTUMN. BREWIN' SEASON. DA BEST SEASON!
LEAVES FALLIN'. TIME TA CHECK DA CHIMNEY BEFORE WINTER CHECKS IT FOR ME!
AUTUMN. WOOD STACKED, COAL ORDERED, GRUDGES SORTED!
HARVEST BEER IZ IN. ME HEART IZ FULL, ME TANKARD FULLER!
AUTUMN WIND IN DA BEARD. FEELS LIKE DA OLD COUNTRY!
WINTER: WINTER. DA FORGE IZ DA WARMEST PLACE IN TOWN. EVERYONE VISITS!
LONG NIGHTS, LONG SONGS, LONG BEARDS. DWARF SEASON!
ICE ON DA TOOLS. BRING DEM IN, WARM DEM UP, APOLOGISE!
WINTER FEAST SOON. ME HAB BIN GROWIN' ME APPETITE SINCE AUTUMN!
FROST ON DA WINDOWS. PRETTY, LIKE ELF WORK. GONE BY NOON, LIKE ELF WORK!

poor: BREAD AN' DRIPPIN' AGAIN. HONEST FOOD FOR AN HONEST PURSE!
MENDED ME BOOTS A {THIRD|FIFTH|SEVENTH} TIME. DEY IZ MORE PATCH DEN BOOT!
SOLD ME SECOND HAMMER. A DWARF WIT ONE HAMMER IZ HALF A DWARF!
NO COIN FOR COAL. COLD FORGE, COLD HEART!
POOR, AYE. BUT NOBODY CAN SAY ME WORK IZ POOR!
WATER INSTEAD OF ALE TONIGHT. ME ANCESTORS IZ TURNIN' IN DEY CAIRNS!
comfortable: ENOUGH FOR COAL, ENOUGH FOR ALE, A LIL' FOR DA GOOD BEARD OIL. PLENTY!
STEADY WORK, STEADY PAY. LIKE A STEADY HAMMER!
BOUGHT NEW TONGS, SIMPLY COZ ME WANTED DEM. DAT IZ COMFORT!
RENT PAID, LARDER FULL, GRUDGES UP TA DATE. A GOOD MONTH!
PUT A LIL' ASIDE FOR {A NEW ANVIL|ME NEPHEW'S APPRENTICESHIP|A BARREL OF GOOD ALE}!
SOLID ACCOUNTS. LIKE A GOOD WALL!
rich: COMMISSIONED A GOLD-INLAID TANKARD. FOR ME. EVERY DWARF DESERVES ONE!
BOUGHT DA WHOLE ME. WELL, A SHARE. A BIG SHARE!
RICH ENOUGH TA PAY OFF ME GRUDGES. NO GOING TA. GRUDGES IZ NO FOR SALE!
ME VAULT DOOR IZ A METRE OF STEEL. ME FORGED IT ME. TWICE!
BOUGHT A ROUND FOR DA WHOLE TAVERN. {TWICE|THREE TIMES|ALL NIGHT}!
VARLENIA FOLK KEEP INVITIN' ME TA DINNER. DEY IZ AFTER ME VAULT DOOR. ME COMPANY BARELY INTERESTS DEM!

familiar: DOZE TRAVELLERS AGAIN. ME {REMEMBER DEM WELL|HAB NO FORGOTTEN|NEVER FORGET} FACES LIKE DEY!
AH, DA ONES WIT DA VAN. DEY OWE ME NUTTIN'. YET!
BACK AGAIN? GOOD. FAMILIAR FACES IZ LIKE OLD TOOLS: DEY FIT DA HAND!
DOZE FOLK. DEY PAID FAIR LAST TIME. DAT GOES IN DA GOOD BOOK!
ME KNOW DAT LOT. ONE OF DEM LEANS ON ME WALLS!
DA TRAVELLERS! SOMEBODY PUT DA KETTLE ON. AN' DA ALE!
DEM AGAIN. A DWARF NEVER FORGETS A FACE, OR A DEBT, OR A KINDNESS!
DERE DEY IZ. STILL IN ONE PIECE, ME SEE. MOSTLY!
DOZE WANDERERS. DEY BOOTS LOOK WORSE EACH TIME. ME COULD FIX DEM!
FAMILIAR FACES. ME WILL NOD. A DWARF NOD IZ WORTH A HUG FROM ANYONE ELSE!
hordeGround: HORDE GROUND. DEY HAB PULLED DOWN GOOD STONE WALLS TA BUILD UGLY ONES!
GOBLIN BANNERS ON A DWARF-BUILT BRIDGE. ME GRANDFATHER WOULD WEEP!
DA HORDE KEEPS EVERYTINK EXCEPT GRUDGES!
HORDE LAND. HAMMER CLOSE, MOUTH SHUT, EYES OPEN!
ME IZ WRITIN' EVERY GOBLIN ME SEE INTO DA BOOK. ME WILL NEED A BIGGER BOOK!
DEY FORGES BURN TOO HOT AN' TOO FAST. EVERYTINK DEY MAKE CRACKS BY SPRING!
DEY PAINT EVERYTINK. PAINT HIDES BAD WORK. ME WOULD KNOW!
ONE SHARED HEAD, DEY SAY. ME WOULD LIKE A WORD WIT IT!
HORDE GROUND. KEEP DA BEARD TUCKED. DEY GRAB!
EVEN HERE DA MOUNTAINS IZ NO DEY. MOUNTAINS BELONG TA NOBODY, AN' A LIL' TA DWARVES!
abroad: FAR FROM DA HALLS. DA BEER HERE IZ A FOREIGN CONCEPT, IN EVERY SENSE!
DEY BUILD WIT BRICK HERE. BRICK! LIKE BREAD FOR WALLS!
NOBODY HERE HAB HEARD OF ME FAMILY. DEY LOSS!
A LONG WAY FROM HOME. ME BOOTS KNOW EVERY MILE OF IT!
FOREIGNERS KEEP ASKIN' IF DA BEARD IZ REAL. PULL IT AN' SEE. GENTLY!
WROTE HOME. TOLD DEM DA STONE HERE IZ SOFT AN' DA PEOPLE SOFTER!
ABROAD, A DWARF IZ A RUMOUR. ME IZ HAPPY TA BE A SOLID ONE!
DA LOCALS HERE IZ KIND. KIND, AN' REAL TALL!
NO DWARF HALL FOR {A HUNDRED|THREE HUNDRED|FIVE HUNDRED} KILOMETRES. ME IZ DA HALL NOW!
STRANGE LAND, STRANGE FOOD, SAME HAMMER. EVERYTINK IZ FINE!

forge: A DWARF CHILD'S FIRST WORD IZ OFTEN 'HOT'. FORGE CHILDREN LEARN FAST!
WE NAME OUR ANVILS. ME IZ CALLED PATIENCE. SHE IZ NO!
A BLADE TAKES {A HUNDRED|A THOUSAND|TEN THOUSAND} STRIKES. A REPUTATION TAKES ONE BAD ONE!
THINKERERS IZ DWARVES WHO FORGE IDEAS. MOST OF DEM EXPLODE. SOME OF DEM FLY!
DA FIRE IN DA OLD HALL HAB NO GONE OUT IN FOUR HUNDRED YEARS. SOMEONE ALWAYS STAYS!
NEVER QUENCH IN ANGER. DA STEEL REMEMBERS!
DA MAGES' GUILD BUYS OUR STEEL FOR DEY STAFF CAPS. DEY NEVER ASK HOW. WE NEVER TELL!
A MASTER'S MARK IZ TINY AN' HIDDEN. IF YOU HAB TA SHOW IT, DA WORK WAZ NO GOOD ENOUGH!
deep: DEEP DOWN, DA STONE IZ WARM AN' IT HUMS. MINERS SAY IT IZ DA WORLD THINKIN'!
SINCE 1992, SOME TUNNELS COME OUT SOMEWHERE DEY DID NO GO IN. WE MARK DOZE WIT RED CHALK!
EVERY MINER KNOWS DA CANARY. OURS SING IN HARMONY!
NEVER WHISTLE IN A ME. DA MOUNTAIN THINKS YOU IZ MOCKIN' IT!
ME GRANDMOTHER FOUND A SEAM OF {SILVER|BLUE QUARTZ|SOMETINK NAMELESS} DAT HUMMED IN TWO DIMENSIONS AT ONCE!
UNDER DA ALPS DERE IZ HALLS OLDER DEN ANY MAP. WE DO NO DRAW DEM ON MAPS!
STONE TELLS YOU WHERE IT WILL BREAK, IF YOU LISTEN. MOST PEOPLE DO NO LISTEN!
A CAVE-IN IZ DA MOUNTAIN CHANGIN' ITS MIND. YOU RESPECT DAT, AN' YOU DIG FASTER!
grudges: ME FAMILY'S GRUDGE BOOK RUNS TA {ELEVEN|FOURTEEN|TWENTY} VOLUMES. LOUDNESS ONE IZ MOSTLY 'BOUT A GOAT!
A GRUDGE IZ CROSSED OUT ONLY WHEN DA DEBT IZ PAID. SOME OF DA INK IZ THREE HUNDRED YEARS OLD!
WE REMEMBER PRECISELY. DAT IZ ALL. CALLIN' IT HATE IZ A MISMEASUREMENT!
GRANDFATHER HELD A GRUDGE AGAINST A BRIDGE FOR FORTY YEARS. DA BRIDGE FELL FIRST!
DERE IZ A PAGE IN DA BOOK FOR DA HORDE. IT IZ A REAL LONG PAGE!
FORGIVIN' IZ ALLOWED. FORGETTIN' IZ NO. DAT IZ DA WHOLE RULE!
ME AUNT CROSSED OUT A GRUDGE ON HER DEATHBED. DA FAMILY STILL TALKS 'BOUT IT!
A GOOD GRUDGE MAKES YOU WORK HARDER. SPITE HAB BUILT MORE HALLS DEN GOLD!
ale: EVERY HALL HAB ITS OWN YEAST. OURS CAME OVER DA MOUNTAINS IN A BEARD. DO NO ASK!
A WEDDIN' NEEDS THREE BARRELS: ONE FOR DA GUESTS, ONE FOR DA FAMILY, ONE FOR DA ARGUMENTS!
ALE IZ LIQUID BREAD. BREAD IZ SOLID ALE. DA CYCLE IZ SACRED!
WE TOAST DA DEAD WIT DARK ALE AN' DA NEWBORN WIT LIGHT. EVERYONE IN BETWEEN GETS WHAT IZ LEFT!
NEVER BREW IN A HURRY. HURRIED ALE TASTES LIKE REGRET!
ME UNCLE BREWED A STOUT SO THICK YOU COULD {STAND A SPOON|FLOAT A COIN|DRIVE A NAIL} IN IT!
VALKYRIES DRINK LAST AT DA FEAST. IT IZ AN HONOUR. DEY PRETEND IT IZ NO A HARDSHIP!
A SINGER DRINKS FREE IN ANY HALL. DAT IZ WHY WE HAB SO MANY SINGERS!
beards: A BEARD IZ A RECORD. EVERY BRAID IZ A DEED, EVERY BEAD A PROMISE!
CUTTIN' A DWARF'S BEARD IZ A CRIME IN THREE COUNTRIES AN' A WAR IN A FOURTH!
ME FIRST BRAID WAZ FOR ME FIRST HINGE. ME WAZ {NINE|ELEVEN|TWELVE}!
VALKYRIES BRAID STEEL WIRE INTO DEY. IT STOPS A SWORD. IT HAB ALSO STOPPED A WEDDIN'!
BEARD OIL RECIPES IZ FAMILY SECRETS. OURS HAB JUNIPER AN' SOMETINK WE DO NO NAME!
CLEAN-SHAVEN DWARVES EXIST. WE IZ POLITE 'BOUT IT. MOSTLY!
TUCK YA BEARD NEAR MACHINES. EVERY DWARF LEARNS DIS EXACTLY ONCE!
A GREY BEARD IZ SEASONED, LIKE GOOD TIMBER!
squishing: VARLENIA APPEARED IN ONE NIGHT IN JANUARY. NUTTIN' BUILT IN A NIGHT CAN BE TRUSTED. NO EVEN A CONTINENT!
DA RULE OF 80: NUTTIN' FASTER DEN EIGHTY AN HOUR. DWARVES OBEYED IT FOR CENTURIES BEFORE IT EXISTED!
DAT OMEGA TOWER GOES DOWN FURTHER DEN IT GOES UP, DEY SAY. ME WOULD LOVE TA SEE ITS FOOTINGS!
NINETY-TWO DIMENSIONS, SQUEEZIN' TOGETHER SINCE 1992. SOMEWHERE, A REAL BAD MASON IZ RESPONSIBLE!
A TIME BUBBLE SWALLOWED A QUARRY NEAR US. DA SAME BLOCK GETS CUT EVERY MORNIN', FOREVER!
DAT LIMINAL ENGINE FOLDS DA ROAD. CLEVER. ME WOULD NEVER RIDE IN IT. ME WOULD TAKE IT APART, THOUGH!
RICH FOLK MOVED TA VARLENIA BY DA BOATLOAD. LET DEM. ITS STONE HAB NO MEMORY!
SINCE DA SQUISHING, SOME ORES TURN UP FROM {OTHER WORLDS|NOWHERE|TOMORROW}. DEY RING WRONG ON DA ANVIL!

positive: {b}! ME FIXED YA GATE. IT SQUEAKED. ME COULD NO BEAR IT!
YOU NO HAB TA DO DAT, {a}. THANK YOU!
ME DID HAB TA. DA SQUEAK WAZ PERSONAL!
FIRST ROUND IZ ON ME, {b}. SECOND ONE TOO!
WHAT IZ DA OCCASION?
YOU PAID ME BACK ON TIME. DAT EARNS A DWARF'S RESPECT AN' TWO PINTS!
ME MADE YOU SOMETINK. A KNIFE. DO NO ARGUE!
IT IZ BEAUTIFUL. LOOK AT DA HANDLE!
ASH WOOD, OILED THREE TIMES. IT WILL OUTLIVE BOTH OF US!
DEN ME WILL LEAVE IT TA SOMEONE IN ME WILL!
YOU REMEMBERED ME GRANDFATHER'S NAME, {b}. NOBODY REMEMBERS!
YOU TOLD DA STORY FOUR TIMES. IT STUCK!
FOUR TIMES! DEN YOU IZ PRACTICALLY FAMILY!
YA NEW SHELF IZ LEVEL. ME CHECKED. ME WAZ IMPRESSED!
COMIN' FROM YOU, DAT IZ SOMETINK!
IT IZ EVERYTINK. DO NO LET IT GO TA YA HEAD!
SING WIT ME, {b}. DA OLD MININ' SONG!
ME NO KNOW DA WORDS.
NOBODY KNOWS DA WORDS. DAT IZ NO DA POINT OF DA SONG!
FINE. LOUDLY, DEN.
ME IZ CROSSIN' YOU OUT OF DA BOOK, {b}!
WHAT BOOK?
DA GRUDGE BOOK. DAT BUSINESS WIT DA LADDER. FORGIVEN!
ME NO EVEN KNOW ME WAZ IN IT!
SINCE 1996. DO NO WORRY. IT WAZ A LIL' ENTRY!
YA BREAD IZ GOOD, {b}. HEAVY. HONEST!
HEAVY IZ A COMPLIMENT?
